entities.name: Juan Manuel Sánchez Gordillo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Manuel Sánchez Gordillo is a Spanish politician, labour leader and history school teacher. He was the Mayor of Marinaleda from 1979 to 2023, and MP for United Left (IU) in the Parliament of Andalusia for 12 years. He is the founder and longtime leader of the party Unitarian Candidacy of Workers (CUT), part of UF and the rural workers's union Andalusian Workers' Union.
